Bladeleaf Aura.name: Bladeleaf Aura
Bladeleaf Aura.description: 5 + 1/F plants spring up defensively around a target, moving with them. Should they be hit by an attack with an attack roll, one of these plants interposes and sacrifices themselves. If it is a single target offensive spell, 2 of the plants can sacrifice themselves for the target. The plants wither when hit no matter how much damage is done to them. Only one instance of this spell can be active on a target at any given time.

Blessing of Creation.name: Blessing of Creation
Blessing of Creation.description: Caster touches a number of targets, granting them a shield that blocks 16 + 4/F damage, but allows all remaining damage to continue onto the target. As long as this shield remains active targets gain a placed roll on WIL, AGI, and HEA resistance checks/saves.

Creeping Consumption.name: Creeping Consumption
Creeping Consumption.description: Vines shoot down the throats of targets in the area, stunning them, HEA check to negate. Affected targets automatically re-attempt at the end of their turn.

Destructive Verdance.name: Destructive Verdance
Destructive Verdance.description: Plants in the area become animated, attacking all targets, inflicting 4 + 1/2F d10 piercing damage each turn they begin in the area, AGI save for half.

Ebb and Flow.name: Ebb and Flow
Ebb and Flow.description: Wisps of energy fly from the caster towards the indicated location. All targets chosen by the caster in the radius may immediately succeed at any resistance check/save they re-attempt during their turn. In addition, the targets recover 6 + 1/F d10 HP.

Entangle.name: Entangle
Entangle.description: Caster uses plants in the area in an attempt to pin all who begin their turn in the radius, AGI check to negate. Affected targets can re-attempt with a swift action.

Lazarite Growth.name: Lazarite Growth
Lazarite Growth.description: Caster infuses energy into an area- reviving plants and healing targets. All targets recover 3d4 + 2/F d4 HP - in addition to automatically bringing any non-sentient dead plant matter back to life . When revived or reinfused with life, plants are adapted to the surroundings in such a way that they are capable of surviving, however extreme. Sentient plants recover 4 + 2/F d10 HP (Including those under the effect of Plantkin) from this spell.

Overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
Overgrowth.description: An array of plantlife covers the target for the duration of the spell, or until the armor breaks. This armor blocks all damage until it has taken 60 + 8/F damage, at which point it breaks (breaking naturally at the end of the duration.) As long as any of the barrier remains, the barrier recovers 20 + 5/F HP at the end of the user's turn up to a maximum of 80HP.

Parasitic Growth.name: Parasitic Growth
Parasitic Growth.description: Dangerous seedlings grow over the surface of the target, these seedlings decrease armor DVs by 6 (Any damage inflicted by the seedlings must be repaired before the armor can provide the same level of benefit) and inflict 3 + 1/4F d12 piercing damage each at the end of the caster's turn, HEA save to negate the armor damage.

Piercing Vine.name: Piercing Vine
Piercing Vine.description: A barbed, piercing vine erupts from the caster's fingertips. The vine impales and wraps around the target inflicting 5 + 1/F d10 piercing damage and pinning them in place, AGI check for half damage and to negate being Pinned. Affected targets can re-attempt with a swift action.

Plantkin.name: Plantkin
Plantkin.description: Caster's body becomes plantlike. Immediately upon casting this spell, and then as a Core Action during all later turns the caster can force a target to be affected by the next turn of any present continuous spells.

Plant Control.name: Plant Control
Plant Control.description:
The caster channels an immense amount of life energy, allowing them to shape and create large amounts of plant life for the duration. Immediately upon casting this spell, and then as a Swift Action during all later turns the caster can use one of the following abilities. 
The caster may grow or reshape trees into walls or shelter, cover the area in plant life adapted to the environment, and turn barren wasteland into verdant jungle. 
Make a ranged attack roll, wrapping a target in strangling vines on hit, pinning them until the end of their next turn. 
Shield a target until the end of their next turn, giving them a 20 HP temporary barrier. Plants created or reshaped persist past the end of the spell's duration.

Rampant Verdance.name: Rampant Verdance
Rampant Verdance.description: Caster concentrates on a (Rank * 5) radius. Plant life begins to erupt in the area, if it is physically impossible the plant life instead immediately dies upon eruption this restriction holds true for all spells in this group that rely upon plantlife.

Regrowth.name: Regrowth
Regrowth.description: Natural energy flows into a willing target, causing them to recover 4+ 1/2F d10 HP at the start of each of their turns. The target glows with an aura of caster's choice.

Seed Scatter.name: Seed Scatter
Seed Scatter.description: Caster directs a stream of leaves outwards, originating from their hands and striking anything in the stream's path, AGI save to negate. Any targets hit by the stream are pushed ten feet back and knocked prone.

Underbrush.name: Underbrush
Underbrush.description: Caster suffocates the magical energies in the area, draining 1d8 mana from any target that ends their turn in the area, and spelljamming them for the whole duration, WIL check to negate. Affected targets can re-attempt with a swift action to stop being spell jammed.

Verdure Movement.name: Verdure Movement
Verdure Movement.description: Caster may use plantlife to maneuver, allowing themselves to use plantlife to lift to lift or catch them, should they be falling. They are not slowed by plants, and walls of plants will move out of the way of the caster. Movement speed in areas with dense plantlife is increased by 30' + 10'/2F. While in the presence of dense plantlife, caster has 1 + 1/4F placed rolls on any AGI checks. Plants are no longer hostile to the caster, causing them to ignore spells such as Destructive Verdance or Entangle.

Wild Growth.name: Wild Growth
Wild Growth.description: Plant life begins to erupt at the target area. All characters are slowed and receive a displaced roll on AGI check and saves while moving through the area.
